chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from Safwan al-Jammal, who said:

I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), 'My family is with me, and I intend to tighten my expenditure around my waist.' So he (peace be upon him) said, 'Yes, for my father (peace be upon him) was saying: From the strength of the traveller is the protection of his expenditure.'
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of tightening the purse around the waist during travel in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Al-Kafi* highlights the practical wisdom of securing one's wealth during travel, linking physical preparedness with financial prudence. Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) validates the practice by referencing Imam al-Baqir (peace be upon him), establishing a chain of scholarly tradition that views safeguarding resources as a key attribute of a 'strong' traveler, emphasizing self-reliance and protection against loss or theft.
